description: What you did and what you saw.

repeats.description: The ID of an earlier observation that you did again.

verdict.description: ok when the result is correct. wrong when it is not.

confirms.description: The ID of an issue or a defect that you did again and saw, for example a1/D3. On the build where it was found, it confirms the issue. On a later build, it sets the status of the issue on that build to not_fixed.

refutes.description: The ID of an issue or a defect that you did again and did not see. On the build where it was found, it refutes the issue. On a later build, it sets the status of the issue on that build to fixed.
